business_summary.text: Alldigi Tech Limited is a business process outsourcing (BPO) and HR technology services provider, offering managed payroll services, HR outsourcing, and technology solutions to global clients.

industry: Services > Commercial Services & Supplies > Business Process Outsourcing (BPO)/ Knowledge Process Outsourcing (KPO)

operating_notes.text: Processed 49.9 lakh employee records in Q4FY26, taking full year to 191.5 lakh records
Added ₹40.1 Cr of new ACV in Tech & Digital business across new and existing customers
Added ₹54.1 Cr of new ACV in BPM business across new and existing customers

timeline.summary: Alldigi Tech Limited held its Q4FY26 and FY26 earnings conference call on May 08, 2026, with newly appointed CEO Natarajan Laxsmanan outlining strategic focus on international expansion and AI enablement.

watchlist.response: Headcount decline is a strategic move to move away from low-margin business and increase international business mix; this rationalization is expected to continue for FY27
watchlist.text: BPM segment headcount decline due to strategic rationalization of low-margin domestic business

watchlist.response: Revenue growth is higher due to one-time activities like configuration changes, tax proof vouching, new wage code implementation, and currency fluctuations from increased international business
watchlist.text: Divergence between payroll process growth and revenue growth in HRO business
